```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

# Safely extract base sequences from whichever data successfully loaded
all_seqs <- c()
if (exists("motu_df")) all_seqs <- c(all_seqs, motu_df$query_id)
if (exists("summary_bold_df")) all_seqs <- c(all_seqs, summary_bold_df$query_id)
if (exists("summary_blast_df")) all_seqs <- c(all_seqs, summary_blast_df$query_title)

overview_df <- data.frame(query_id = unique(all_seqs))

# Merge BOLD top hits if available
if (exists("summary_bold_df")) {
  overview_df <- dplyr::left_join(
    overview_df, 
    summary_bold_df %>% dplyr::select(query_id, BOLD_ID = top_id, BOLD_Hit = hit_id), 
    by = "query_id"
  )
}

# Merge Distance MOTUs if available
if (exists("motu_df")) {
  overview_df <- dplyr::left_join(overview_df, motu_df, by = "query_id")
}

# Merge User Metadata if provided
if (!is.null(params$metadata_path) && params$metadata_path != "" && params$key_col != "") {
  user_meta <- readRDS(params$metadata_path)
  user_meta <- user_meta %>% dplyr::rename(query_id = !!dplyr::sym(params$key_col))
  overview_df <- dplyr::left_join(overview_df, user_meta, by = "query_id")
}

reactable::reactable(
  overview_df,
  theme = dynamic_theme,
  highlight = TRUE,
  compact = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  columns = list(
    query_id = reactable::colDef(name = "Sequence Name", minWidth = 150, sticky = "left"),
    BOLD_ID = reactable::colDef(name = "BOLD Result", minWidth = 150),
    motu = reactable::colDef(name = "MOTU Cluster", minWidth = 100)
  )
)
```
